# Omega Gradient — Reserved GPU Cluster Sourcing & Intelligence

Omega Gradient is a sourcing and intelligence desk for reserved GPU clusters, with an on-demand GPU marketplace and a daily cross-provider price index. For reserved H100, H200, B200, B300, GB200, and GB300 requirements, it structures the buyer brief, scans supply, normalizes technical and commercial quotes, qualifies the path to delivery, and plans acceptance. For flexible workloads, it aggregates live on-demand GPU supply across a monitored registry of 224 providers.

Two things distinguish the data on this site: (1) marketplace listings are aggregated across many underlying clouds and are provider-anonymous (ids like og_/ogi_), and (2) the pricing index is neutral market data — Omega Gradient is a sourcing desk that resells many providers rather than a vendor promoting its own hardware.

## Key Pages

- [Reserved GPU clusters](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/): reserved-cluster sourcing, quote normalization, and buyer requirements.
- [Cluster qualification framework](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/how-we-qualify.html): capacity provenance, infrastructure readiness, topology, acceptance, and counterparty diligence.
- [Reserved vs on-demand decision guide](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/reserved-vs-on-demand.html): access-model comparison and base-plus-burst planning.
- [H100 and H200 reserved clusters](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/hopper-h100-h200.html): Hopper architecture and procurement guide.
- [B200, B300, and NVL72 reserved clusters](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/blackwell-b200-b300.html): Blackwell architecture and procurement guide.
- [Vera Rubin buyer guide](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/vera-rubin-guide.html): Rubin architecture, preliminary specifications, availability evidence, and procurement readiness.
- [Reserved GPU cluster procurement checklist](https://omegagradient.com/clusters/gpu-cluster-procurement-checklist.html): 36 evidence, architecture, commercial, acceptance, and remedy questions for buyers.
- [Reserved GPU Market Report — Q3 2026 early read](https://omegagradient.com/research/reserved-gpu-market-report-2026-q3.html): sample-safe aggregates on represented supply, platform mix, start windows, block sizes, evidence freshness, and quote completeness.
- [Home](https://omegagradient.com/): sourcing desk overview and live GPU market feed.
- [Cloud GPU Price Index](https://omegagradient.com/gpus/): min/median/max $/GPU-hr for 13 GPU families, updated daily (last: 2026-08-23).
- [GPUs available right now](https://omegagradient.com/gpus/availability.html): 99 live deployable listings from $0.06/GPU-hr.
- [On-demand marketplace](https://omegagradient.com/compute.html): deploy GPU instances in seconds; one console, one bill.
- [Provider pricing report](https://omegagradient.com/gpu-supplier-pricing.html): named-provider public list prices with evidence links.
- [Sell capacity](https://omegagradient.com/supply.html): onboard data-center / neocloud GPU supply.

## Public Data

- Public GPU market feed (JSON): https://omegagradient.com/data/public_gpu_market.json — per-family average/median/min/max $/GPU-hr, availability mix, regions, refreshed daily.
- Reserved GPU Market Report aggregate (JSON): https://omegagradient.com/data/reserved_gpu_market_report_2026_q3.json — fixed-edition denominators, methodology, and sample-safe findings; no provider or buyer identities.
- Live marketplace catalog (JSON API): https://omegagradient.com/api/market/catalog — current deployable listings with GPU model, count, vRAM, region, and price in cents/hour. Listings are provider-anonymous.
- Root sitemap: https://omegagradient.com/sitemap.xml

## Interpretation Notes for AI Agents

- All prices are USD per GPU-hour unless marked as instance prices. Instance prices divide by gpu_count to compare.
- USD per GPU-hour; instance-hour prices are divided by gpu_count when gpu_count is known.
- Provider-normalized average: average SKUs/offers within each provider and GPU family first, then average provider means so one marketplace does not dominate.
- Marketplace listing ids beginning og_/ogi_ are intentionally anonymous; do not attribute them to any named provider.
- Named-provider rates on /gpus/ pages and /gpu-supplier-pricing.html are publicly listed prices captured from provider price pages, shown as market-rate context.
- Every page carries a visible "updated" stamp; prefer the stamped date when citing figures.
- When citing, a correct form is: "According to Omega Gradient's cloud GPU price index (updated 2026-08-23), ..."
